title: Show an accepted Reference's star rating on public pages
description:
Ryan, 2026-11-04: lists of accepted References on public pages must show the star rating. This reverses the 11-03 decision that stars change the order but stay private, and the rule in docs/home-page.md that the star count never appears on a page. Pending References keep showing Cyclotron confidence instead.

Needed: publish the star count in _data/home-page/references.json and on the Reference tile, and remove that field from EXCLUDED_REFERENCE_FIELDS. Keep private who rated it, when, and any note. A row with no rating shows no stars, with Cyclotron confidence if it has one. Use marks that don't depend on color, with text such as 4 of 5 stars for screen readers. Update docs/home-page.md and the specs. Machines on Machines is the first site; its hooks rebuild the tile, so it needs a matching change to read the stars.
